## Limits of this file

- Timestamps are the start of the speech segment, in the original video's time.
- Transcripts are machine-made. Names and technical words may be wrong.
- Terms match exact words without stemming: grinder and grinders are separate. No understanding of meaning.
- Trends follow the stated video order and need at least three usable videos, at least 3 matches in every video and 30 total; smaller samples are too few to call a trend.
- Steady means sufficient counts but equal endpoints or a change below the direction threshold; it does not establish stability. Equal endpoint rates never get a direction. Rising/falling requires a 25% change in both endpoints and first/last half means, with at least two-thirds of adjacent steps agreeing. Labels are descriptive, not statistical significance.
- Everyone who speaks is counted together.
